subject: Finalizing corner pod selection, canopy permit, and collateral delivery windows
messages:
From: Samantha Lowe <samantha@eventco.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Booth allocation options — corner pod C12 (provisional)

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for confirming Redwood for Expo West. We’ve provisionally reserved a street-facing corner pod (C12) on Aisle 4 — it’s a high-traffic spot with direct sightlines coming off the main concourse. I’ve attached a provisional floorplan (v2) showing sightlines and electrical drops.

Two quick notes:
- Corner pods like C12 get preferred foot traffic but have a canopy height restriction of 9ft; if you plan a taller backwall or suspended signage we’ll need a canopy/permit application and fire marshal sign-off.
- If you’d prefer an island for a 360 demo flow, we can swap you to Island 7 but that would require a footprint change request and an additional fee.

Attachment: floorplan_v2.pdf (PDF)

If you can confirm by end of week we’ll lock the space.

Best,
Samantha

Senior Account Manager — EventCo

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Lowe <samantha@eventco.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth allocation options — corner pod C12 (provisional)

Team — looping you in on space options from EventCo. Corner pod C12 looks strong for our goals (street-facing, high walk-by). Two things I need from each of you: 

- Marissa: can you confirm final collateral counts (paper one-pagers, kits, promo cards, and swag crates) and whether we want two demo stations or three? Also recommend printer/vendor for pop-ups and quick signage.
- Logan: confirm AV footprint and whether the 9ft canopy limit is workable for our demo monitors and banner stands. Also note power drops on the plan.
- Grace: quick sightline check — any risk of being obscured by adjacent sponsor islands?

Samantha flagged the canopy height restriction and permit requirement if we go with tall suspended signage. I’m inclined to accept C12 but I want to be sure we can get permit paperwork in time. If we move to an island we’ll need a footprint change and additional logistics costs.

I’ve attached their floorplan v2 for reference. Please reply with short bullet answers; we need to lock by Friday EOD.

Attachment: floorplan_v2.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Naomi
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth allocation options — corner pod C12 (provisional)

Short answers:
- Collateral counts (final recommended manifest): 1,000 one-pagers (product overview), 800 two-sided quick-cards (contacts + CTA), 6 demo kits (boxed), 3 swag crates (t-shirts + stickers). See attached collateral_manifest.csv for SKU-level breakdown and box dimensions.
- Demo stations: recommend 3 small demo pedestals (two for live walkthroughs, one reserved for overflow/press).
- Pop-up banners and canopy-facing vinyl: recommend BrightPrints (we’ve used them twice). Lead time for 3 pop-ups + two 48" vinyl strips is 7–10 business days.

I’m forwarding a quick quote request I started with BrightPrints — they’ll confirm final pricing if we send art files and sizes. Also note: crate ID labels needed for union loading docs.

Attachment: collateral_manifest.csv (CSV)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Events Program Manager
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: BrightPrints Inc. <orders@brightprints.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Jul 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quote: pop-ups, vinyl strips, and canopy vinyl — Redwood Expo West

Hi Marissa / Naomi,

Thanks for the RFQ. We can do 3 x 33x80 pop-up banners, 2 x 48in canopy vinyl strips, and rush digital proofing in 48 hours. Estimated costs: 
- Pop-ups: $180 each (matte, 6–8 day turnaround)
- Vinyl strips: $120 each (weatherproof laminate)
- Setup + crating for show floor delivery: $210

Total (estimate, before tax & shipping): $950.

Important permit note: for canopy-facing vinyl that exceeds the 9ft height restriction, EventCo or the fire marshal may require a canopy permit. We include a canopy_permit_application.pdf that lists materials and flame-test certifications — please confirm if you want us to submit to the marshal on your behalf (we charge a $75 convenience fee for submissions). Lead time for production + shipping: 10 business days from art approval.

Attachment: canopy_permit_application.pdf (PDF)

We’ll need a site contact for day-of receipt and a PO or credit-card authorization to lock the order.

Regards,
Carlos Mendes
Accounts — BrightPrints Inc.
orders@brightprints.com
+1 (408) 555-6622

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha@eventco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, BrightPrints Inc. <orders@brightprints.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jul 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth allocation options — corner pod C12 (provisional) — final decision

Team / Samantha / BrightPrints — final confirmation and next steps:

1) Space: We will accept corner pod C12. The street-facing position aligns with our lead-gen plan and press hooks. Samantha — please lock C12 and confirm freight window and union loading docs.

2) Signage & canopy: Approving BrightPrints quote (estimate $950) and approving BrightPrints to submit the canopy permit application to the fire marshal on our behalf (please include the $75 convenience fee on final invoice). BrightPrints: submit the permit package and copy me when filed.

3) Collateral & crates: Marissa’s manifest looks good. Shipping schedule: crates to arrive to EventCo crossdock between Sep 18–20 with onsite crate ID labels (I’ll coordinate label content). Marissa — please create the PO and route to procurement for approval this week.

4) AV: Logan — please confirm the 9ft canopy limit is compatible with our 3 demo pedestals; if not, advise whether we can use lower monitors or request a variance from the marshal.

Attachments: floorplan_v3.pdf (PDF)
Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Redwood-Booth-Plans (final build folder)
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company.com/deal/DEAL-4982

Thanks all — locking this now so vendors can begin proofs and permit work.
